course_name_original: LABORATORIO DI MECCANICA DELLE VIBRAZIONI E SPERIMENTAZIONE SUI SISTEMI MECCANICI M
course_name_en: MECHANICAL VIBRATIONS LABORATORY AND EXPERIMENTATION ON MECHANICAL SYSTEMS M

learning_outcomes.text: Students are introduced to experimental procedures and methods for identification, design, analysis of dynamical models of mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Experimental and numerical techniques for experimental identification of mechanical systems
Numerical modeling techniques for multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical systems
Identification of structural and modal system parameters
Numerical and experimental applications of identification techniques
Free and forced vibration of single and multi-degree-of-freedom systems, real and complex damping
Experimental modal analysis (EMA): time and frequency domain identification techniques
Application examples: model identification and structural modification
Signal analysis and processing techniques: Fourier Series, DFT, FFT, continuous Fourier and Laplace transform operator
Numerical simulation and real time experimental applications in laboratory
teaching_methods: Lectures with notebook and overhead projector

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination: discussion of the topics listed in the program.
Discussion of a specific topic or solution of a numerical application concerning mechanical vibrations with experimental application.
